HGF parameter analyses (Supplementary Tables S1-S2) are in ESB_HGF_analyses.R.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(psych)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(broom)

DIR <- "G:/My Drive/Emotion Regulation and Conspiracy Thinking/Data/"

# FDR-corrected (Benjamini-Hochberg) correlation matrix
cor_fdr <- function(df, use = "pairwise", method = "pearson") {
  ct <- psych::corr.test(df, use = use, method = method, adjust = "BH")
  q  <- ct$p
  q[lower.tri(q)] <- t(q)[lower.tri(q)]
  list(r = round(ct$r, 2), q = round(q, 3), n = ct$n)
}
```

## Phase 1: load, exclusions, scoring

```{r phase1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Raw <- read_csv(paste0(DIR, "dataphase1_5_14_25.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

phase1 <- Raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Progress))), Status != "Survey Preview") %>%
  mutate(Progress = as.numeric(Progress)) %>%
  filter(Progress >= 99) %>%
  mutate(
    age   = as.numeric(Q241),
    ATC5  = abs(as.numeric(EOS_1) + age - year(RecordedDate)) <= 1,
    n_impl = (ATQ_1 == "False") + (ATQ_2 == "False") + (ATQ_3 == "True")
  ) %>%
  filter((ATC5 %in% TRUE & n_impl >= 2) | (is.na(ATC5) & n_impl == 3))

# CRT
phase1 <- phase1 %>%
  mutate(CRT_4 = case_when(
    grepl("This is a trickish question.", CRT_4) ~ "0", #ppt answers "first or second", still wrong
    CRT_4 %in% c("sdecond", "secod") ~ "2", #typos
    TRUE ~ CRT_4
  ))

# ERQ: expressive suppression = 2, 4, 6, 9; cognitive reappraisal = 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10
# TAS-20: reverse-scored items 4, 5, 10, 18, 19 on a 1-5 scale
TAS_rev   <- paste0("TAS20_", c(4, 5, 10, 18, 19), "_1")
DIF_items <- paste0("TAS20_", c(1, 3, 6, 7, 9, 13, 14), "_1")
DDF_items <- paste0("TAS20_", c(2, 4, 11, 12, 17), "_1")
EOT_items <- paste0("TAS20_", c(5, 8, 10, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20), "_1")

phase1 <- phase1 %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(starts_with("ERQ_"), starts_with("TAS20_")), ~ as.numeric(str_extract(.x, "^[0-9]+"))),
    across(c(starts_with("BCTI_"), starts_with("VCB_")),  ~ as.numeric(str_extract(.x, "\\d+"))),
    across(all_of(TAS_rev), ~ 6 - .x),
    ERQ_ES    = rowSums(across(paste0("ERQ_", c(2, 4, 6, 9), "_1")), na.rm = TRUE),
    ERQ_CR    = rowSums(across(paste0("ERQ_", c(1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10), "_1")), na.rm = TRUE),
    TAS_DIF   = rowSums(across(all_of(DIF_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
    TAS_DDF   = rowSums(across(all_of(DDF_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
    TAS_EOT   = rowSums(across(all_of(EOT_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
    TAS_total = TAS_DIF + TAS_DDF + TAS_EOT,
    BCTI_total = rowSums(across(starts_with("BCTI_")), na.rm = TRUE),
    vaxConspiracyBelief_total = rowSums(across(starts_with("VCB_")), na.rm = TRUE),
    CRT_total = as.integer(CRT_1 == 4) + as.integer(CRT_2 == 10) + as.integer(CRT_3 == 39) +
      as.integer(grepl("\\b(second|2)\\b", CRT_4, ignore.case = TRUE)) +
      as.integer(CRT_5 == 8) +
      as.integer(grepl("emily|enily", CRT_6, ignore.case = TRUE)) + #single correct answer of "enily"
      as.integer(CRT_7 == 0)
  ) %>%
  select(prolific_id = Q253, PROLIFIC_PID, Progress, EndDate,
         age, gender = Q262, race = Q258, hispanic_latino = Q259,
         fam_income = Q10, political_party = Q13,
         ERQ_ES, ERQ_CR, TAS_DIF, TAS_DDF, TAS_EOT, TAS_total,
         BCTI_total, vaxConspiracyBelief_total, CRT_total,
         all_of(c(DIF_items, DDF_items, EOT_items)),
         education = Q9, Duration = `Duration (in seconds)`, CRT_1:CRT_8,
         matches("^(ERQ|BCTI|VCB)_[0-9]+_1$"))

# Phase 1 analysis sample (n = 1307)
phase1_ids <- read.csv(paste0(DIR, "phase1_id_list.txt"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
data <- phase1 %>%
  filter(prolific_id %in% phase1_ids$prolific_id) %>%
  arrange(desc(Progress), desc(EndDate)) %>%
  distinct(prolific_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Matrix reasoning (n = 1199; 108 participants did not complete the task)
dataMR <- read_csv(paste0(DIR, "matrixScored_20251006.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(ID, MR_total = totalScore)
data <- data %>% left_join(dataMR, by = c("prolific_id" = "ID"))

cat("Phase 1 n:", nrow(data), " with matrix reasoning:", sum(!is.na(data$MR_total)), "\n")
```

## Table 2: descriptives and reliability

```{r table2}
crt_items <- with(data, data.frame(
  c1 = CRT_1 == 4, c2 = CRT_2 == 10, c3 = CRT_3 == 39,
  c4 = grepl("\\b(second|2)\\b", CRT_4, ignore.case = TRUE), c5 = CRT_5 == 8,
  c6 = grepl("emily|enily", CRT_6, ignore.case = TRUE), c7 = CRT_7 == 0)) * 1

scale_items <- list(
  BCTI_total = grep("^BCTI_[0-9]+_1$", names(data), value = TRUE),
  vaxConspiracyBelief_total = grep("^VCB_[0-9]+_1$", names(data), value = TRUE),
  ERQ_CR = paste0("ERQ_", c(1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10), "_1"),
  ERQ_ES = paste0("ERQ_", c(2, 4, 6, 9), "_1"),
  TAS_total = c(DIF_items, DDF_items, EOT_items),
  TAS_DIF = DIF_items, TAS_DDF = DDF_items, TAS_EOT = EOT_items)

desc <- function(x) c(M = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), SD = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                      Min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE), Max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
# KR-21 for matrix reasoning (35 items; only total scores are available)
kr21 <- function(x, k = 35) { x <- na.omit(x); m <- mean(x); (k / (k - 1)) * (1 - m * (k - m) / (k * var(x))) }

table2 <- rbind(
  t(sapply(names(scale_items), function(v)
    c(desc(data[[v]]), Reliability = psych::alpha(data[, scale_items[[v]]], warnings = FALSE)$total$raw_alpha))),
  CRT_total = c(desc(data$CRT_total), Reliability = psych::alpha(crt_items, warnings = FALSE)$total$raw_alpha), # KR-20
  MR_total  = c(desc(data$MR_total), Reliability = kr21(data$MR_total)))
round(table2, 2)
```

## Emotion regulation: two-step regression

```{r er_regression}
er <- data %>% transmute(CR = scale(ERQ_CR)[, 1], ES = scale(ERQ_ES)[, 1], TAS = scale(TAS_total)[, 1],
                         BCTI = scale(BCTI_total)[, 1], VCB = scale(vaxConspiracyBelief_total)[, 1])
for (o in c("BCTI", "VCB")) {
  step1 <- lm(as.formula(paste(o, "~ TAS + ES")), data = er)
  step2 <- lm(as.formula(paste(o, "~ TAS + ES + CR")), data = er)
  print(summary(step1)); print(summary(step2))
  print(anova(step1, step2))
  cat(o, "R2 change:", round(summary(step2)$r.squared - summary(step1)$r.squared, 3), "\n")
}
```

## Robustness checks: completion time and demographic covariates

```{r robustness}
data$Duration <- as.numeric(data$Duration)
for (v in c("MR_total", "BCTI_total", "vaxConspiracyBelief_total", "ERQ_ES"))
  print(cor.test(data$Duration, data[[v]]))

# Exclude participants who finished in less than half the median time
fast <- data$Duration < 0.5 * median(data$Duration)
cat("Excluded fast responders:", sum(fast), "\n")
d_slow <- data[!fast, ] %>%
  mutate(across(c(ERQ_ES, MR_total, BCTI_total, vaxConspiracyBelief_total), ~ scale(.x)[, 1]))
summary(lm(BCTI_total ~ ERQ_ES * MR_total, data = d_slow))
summary(lm(vaxConspiracyBelief_total ~ ERQ_ES * MR_total, data = d_slow))

# Demographic covariates
edu_levels <- c("Less than High School", "High School or equivalent", "Associate degree",
                "Bachelor's degree", "Master's degree", "Doctorate degree")
d_cov <- data %>% mutate(
  gender3 = factor(ifelse(gender %in% c("Male", "Female"), gender, "Other"), levels = c("Female", "Male", "Other")),
  edu_z   = scale(match(education, edu_levels) - 1)[, 1],
  inc_z   = scale(income_map[trimws(fam_income)])[, 1],
  age_z   = scale(age)[, 1],
  party   = relevel(factor(ifelse(political_party %in% c("Democrat", "Republican"), political_party, "Other")), "Democrat"))
summary(lm(BCTI_total_z ~ ERQ_ES_z * MR_total_z + age_z + gender3 + edu_z + inc_z + party, data = d_cov))
summary(lm(vaxConspiracyBelief_total_z ~ ERQ_ES_z * MR_total_z + age_z + gender3 + edu_z + inc_z + party, data = d_cov))
```

## Figures 2A and 2B

```{r figures2, message=FALSE}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(MR_group = cut(MR_total_z, breaks = c(-Inf, -1, 1, Inf), labels = c("-1 SD", "Mean", "+1 SD")))

mod_plot <- function(model, outcome_z, ylab) {
  coefs  <- coef(model)
  slopes <- coefs["ERQ_ES_z"] + coefs["ERQ_ES_z:MR_total_z"] * c(-1, 0, 1)
  names(slopes) <- c("-1 SD", "Mean", "+1 SD")
  pred <- expand.grid(ERQ_ES_z = seq(min(data$ERQ_ES_z), max(data$ERQ_ES_z), length.out = 200),
                      MR_total_z = c(-1, 0, 1))
  pred$fit <- predict(model, newdata = pred)
  pred$MR_group <- factor(pred$MR_total_z, levels = c(-1, 0, 1), labels = c("-1 SD", "Mean", "+1 SD"))

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = data, aes(x = ERQ_ES_z, y = .data[[outcome_z]], color = MR_group), alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_smooth(data = pred, aes(x = ERQ_ES_z, y = fit, color = MR_group),
                method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("-1 SD" = "firebrick", "Mean" = "black", "+1 SD" = "blue"),
                       labels = paste0(names(slopes), "  \u03b2 = ", round(slopes, 3)),
                       na.translate = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-3, 3, by = 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-3, 3, by = 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, 2.5), ylim = c(-2, 3)) +
    labs(x = "Expressive Suppression", y = ylab, color = "Matrix Reasoning") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
          axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
          axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
          axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank())
}

fig2A <- mod_plot(model_bcti, "BCTI_total_z", "General Conspiracy Beliefs")
fig2B <- mod_plot(model_vax, "vaxConspiracyBelief_total_z", "Vaccine Conspiracy Beliefs")
fig2A
fig2B

# Figure notes: group sizes and simple slopes (95% CI) at -1 SD, mean, +1 SD of matrix reasoning
table(data$MR_group)
for (m in list(BCTI = model_bcti, VCB = model_vax)) for (at in c(-1, 0, 1)) {
  refit <- update(m, data = mutate(data, MR_total_z = MR_total_z - at))
  print(cbind(MR_at = at, coef(summary(refit))["ERQ_ES_z", , drop = FALSE], confint(refit)["ERQ_ES_z", , drop = FALSE]))
}
```

## Table 5: Phase 2 demographics

```{r table5}
demo <- function(d) {
  income <- income_map[trimws(d$fam_income)]
  data.frame(
    N = nrow(d),
    Age = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(as.numeric(d$age)), sd(as.numeric(d$age))),
    Gender_MFO = paste(sum(d$gender == "Male"), sum(d$gender == "Female"),
                       sum(!d$gender %in% c("Male", "Female")), sep = ":"),
    White = sum(grepl("White", d$race)),
    Black = sum(grepl("Black", d$race)),
    Other = sum(d$hispanic_latino == "Of Hispanic or Latino origin") +
      sum(grepl("Asian|American Indian|Alaska|Hawaiian", d$race)),
    Income = sprintf("$%s ($%s)", format(round(mean(income)), big.mark = ","),
                     format(round(sd(income)), big.mark = ",")),
    BA_or_higher = sum(d$education %in% c("Bachelor's degree", "Master's degree", "Doctorate degree", "Professional degree")),
    Party_DRO = paste(sum(d$political_party == "Democrat"), sum(d$political_party == "Republican"),
                      sum(!d$political_party %in% c("Democrat", "Republican")), sep = ":"),
    BCTI =sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(d$BCTI_total), sd(d$BCTI_total)),
    VCB = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(d$vaxConspiracyBelief_total), sd(d$vaxConspiracyBelief_total)))
}
```

## PRL: group differences and correlations

```{r prl}
# Loss-stay = proportion of trials staying with a deck after a loss (= 1 - loss-switch)
dataPRL_full$l_st_r <- 1 - dataPRL_full$l_sw_r

t.test(w_sw_r ~ ESB_group, data = dataPRL_full)
t.test(l_st_r ~ ESB_group, data = dataPRL_full)

# Spearman's rho, FDR within each set
prl_ws <- cor_fdr(dataPRL_full %>% select(`General Conspiracy (BCTI)` = BCTI_total,
                                          `Vaccine Conspiracy` = vaxConspiracyBelief_total,
                                          `Expressive Suppression (ERQ)` = ERQ_ES, `Win-Switch` = w_sw_r),
                  method = "spearman")
prl_ls <- cor_fdr(dataPRL_full %>% select(`General Conspiracy (BCTI)` = BCTI_total,
                                          `Vaccine Conspiracy` = vaxConspiracyBelief_total,
                                          `Expressive Suppression (ERQ)` = ERQ_ES, `Loss-Stay` = l_st_r),
                  method = "spearman")
rbind(rho = prl_ws$r["Win-Switch", ], q = prl_ws$q["Win-Switch", ])
rbind(rho = prl_ls$r["Loss-Stay", ],  q = prl_ls$q["Loss-Stay", ])
```

## Table 6: expressive suppression x switch rate

```{r table6}
prl_mod <- dataPRL_full %>%
  mutate(ES = scale(ERQ_ES)[, 1], TAS = scale(TAS_total)[, 1], BCTI = scale(BCTI_total)[, 1],
         VCB = scale(vaxConspiracyBelief_total)[, 1],
         WS = scale(w_sw_r)[, 1], LS = scale(l_st_r)[, 1])

fit_prl <- function(outcome, prl, er = "ES") {
  m1 <- lm(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", er, "+", prl)), data = prl_mod)
  m2 <- lm(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", er, "*", prl)), data = prl_mod)
  c1 <- coef(summary(m1)); c2 <- coef(summary(m2))
  data.frame(Outcome = outcome, PRL = prl, ER = er,
             ER_beta = c1[er, 1], ER_p = c1[er, 4],
             Switch_beta = c1[prl, 1], Switch_p = c1[prl, 4],
             Adj_R2 = summary(m1)$adj.r.squared,
             Int_beta = c2[paste0(er, ":", prl), 1], Int_p = c2[paste0(er, ":", prl), 4],
             R2_change = summary(m2)$r.squared - summary(m1)$r.squared)
}

table6 <- bind_rows(fit_prl("BCTI", "WS"), fit_prl("VCB", "WS"),
                    fit_prl("BCTI", "LS"), fit_prl("VCB", "LS")) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
table6

# Same models with TAS total in place of expressive suppression (Supplementary Table S3)
tableS3 <- bind_rows(fit_prl("BCTI", "WS", "TAS"), fit_prl("VCB", "WS", "TAS"),
                     fit_prl("BCTI", "LS", "TAS"), fit_prl("VCB", "LS", "TAS")) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
tableS3
```

## Alexithymia: EFA (2 factors, maximum likelihood, oblimin)

```{r efa}
set.seed(1234)

TAS_items <- c(DIF_items, DDF_items, EOT_items)

tas_efa <- fa(data %>% select(all_of(TAS_items)), nfactors = 2, rotate = "oblimin", fm = "ml")
print(tas_efa$loadings, cutoff = .30)
tas_efa$Phi

# Which factor is which: one should track DIF and DDF, the other EOT
fscores <- as.data.frame(tas_efa$scores)
round(cor(data %>% select(TAS_DIF, TAS_DDF, TAS_EOT), fscores), 2)

# Rename after reading the correlations above
names(fscores) <- c("EmotionAwareness_fs", "EOT_fs")
data <- data %>%
  select(-any_of(c("EmotionAwareness_fs", "EOT_fs", "EmotionAwareness_fs_z", "EOT_fs_z"))) %>%
  bind_cols(fscores) %>%
  mutate(EmotionAwareness_fs_z = as.numeric(scale(EmotionAwareness_fs)),
         EOT_fs_z              = as.numeric(scale(EOT_fs)))
```

## Alexithymia: moderation models and bootstrap

```{r alex_models}
facets   <- c("ERQ_ES", "EmotionAwareness_fs", "EOT_fs")
outcomes <- c("BCTI_total", "vaxConspiracyBelief_total")

facet_labels <- c(ERQ_ES              = "Expressive Suppression",
                  EmotionAwareness_fs = "Emotional Awareness",
                  EOT_fs              = "Externally-Oriented Thinking")

run_facet_model <- function(facet, outcome) {
  f <- reformulate(paste0(facet, "_z * MR_total_z"), response = paste0(outcome, "_z"))
  broom::tidy(lm(f, data = data), conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(facet = facet, outcome = outcome, .before = 1)
}

facet_results <- purrr::pmap_dfr(expand_grid(facet = facets, outcome = outcomes), run_facet_model)

interaction_results <- facet_results %>%
  filter(grepl(":MR_total_z$", term)) %>%
  select(facet, outcome, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
  mutate(facet_label = factor(facet_labels[facet], levels = unname(facet_labels)))
print(interaction_results, n = Inf)

# Paired bootstrap: emotional awareness vs expressive suppression
boot_diff <- function(outcome, n_boot = 2000) {
  f_es <- reformulate("ERQ_ES_z * MR_total_z", response = paste0(outcome, "_z"))
  f_ea <- reformulate("EmotionAwareness_fs_z * MR_total_z", response = paste0(outcome, "_z"))
  diffs <- numeric(n_boot)
  for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
    d <- data[sample(nrow(data), replace = TRUE), ]
    diffs[i] <- coef(lm(f_ea, data = d))[["EmotionAwareness_fs_z:MR_total_z"]] -
                coef(lm(f_es, data = d))[["ERQ_ES_z:MR_total_z"]]
  }
  q <- quantile(diffs, c(.025, .5, .975))
  tibble(outcome = outcome, diff_from_ES = q[2], ci_low = q[1], ci_high = q[3])
}

boot_results <- purrr::map_dfr(outcomes, boot_diff)
boot_results
```
